exceptions.reason: The two selects (the sort bar and the invoice form) stay a native <select>: both are used on phones, where the native picker is the better control (2026-11-10, Q16, brief 12 decision 4). There is no Base UI Select, so rule 10 has nothing to check.

The icon font's own rule in index.css (.material-symbols-outlined, font-size 24px) sits outside every layer and beats a text-* size, so an icon of another size carries an inline fontSize. Moving the rule into a layer would resize every icon that today has a losing text-* class (brief 12 decision 6). An Icon component with a size prop would remove them; it touches 66 files and waits for its own brief.
The same unlayered .material-symbols-outlined rule sets font-variation-settings, so a filled icon (a chosen star, a favourite, a verified badge) sets its own FILL axis inline.
Computed geometry: a progress bar's width is its percentage (rule 5 allows it).
A non-modal banner with role=dialog and aria-modal=false. Base UI has no banner part, and a modal Dialog would be wrong: the page behind it stays usable until the visitor answers.
@my-olx/core is the plugin library the app registers (plugins/, lib/, db/), not a server: buildApp lives in backend/app/src/app.ts, its one consumer (brief 13, decision 1).
loadDevSeedConfig() guards seed:dev, which makes accounts with a known password, by NODE_ENV=development; config.ts is the one place allowed to read it (brief 13, decision 8).
The one decorator: app.authenticate, the preHandler protected routes name. It is not a test seam; tests sign real tokens (Q56, brief 13 decision 6).
The test helper keeps its name, startTestApp, rather than the skill's buildTestApp: renaming touches every test that imports it for nothing (brief 13, decision 7).
